evidence_boundary.purpose: One-replicate implementation and mechanism screen for the preregistered weak-subspace, paired-isotropic and frozen-source-continuation comparison. It cannot promote, reject or tune a production mechanism from performance.

root_seed_derivation.conversion: unsigned big-endian integer from the first eight digest bytes

source_contract.fresh_input: Each case gets one fresh independently seeded D0 maximum matrix; no Stage-A proposal artifact is reused.
source_contract.maximum_prefix: Each case matrix is generated and persisted once with exactly 128 columns.
source_contract.initial_source: Columns 1 through 64 are the common source phase and are identical for all later comparison arms.
source_contract.continuation_source: Columns 65 through 128 are frozen before outcomes and provide IID insurance plus source-continuation slots under the weak-geometry schedule.
source_contract.prefix_identity: Initial and continuation slices are views of the one persisted maximum matrix and are never regenerated.
source_contract.slice_digest_contract: sha256(canonical_json({artifact_sha256,column_range,coordinate_float64_bits_by_column,lane_schedule,source_columns})); Float64 bits are lowercase 16-hex strings in column-major outer order

case_selection.selection_rule: Two pre-existing difficult instances from each of four numerically distinct families, fixed before any Stage-B outcome. Manual parameter reconstruction must match source replay and assessor counts.

mechanism_contract.phase_1: Run frozen E4 on D0 columns 1:64. Immediately before each local return, capture every non-nothing numeric endpoint through a truth-blind wrapper in FIFO source ordinal order; reported acceptance, Gold, family and known targets are not read, and captured anchors retain generation zero.
mechanism_contract.phase_2: Run one geometry-only attempt through the same opaque case API. Scan every FIFO anchor, passing the remaining case-global comparison budget to weak_geometry_plan, including typed zero-budget scans after exhaustion. Geometry produces no answer endpoint; reported callbacks must equal observed callbacks and the scan callback cap is 9000.
mechanism_contract.phase_3: Before any arm solve, persist O_EXCL truth-free matrices in arm order CONTINUATION, ISOTROPIC, WEAK. Every arm has 64 starts based on D0 columns 65:128. Ordinals congruent to 1 mod 4 remain identical IID points in all arms; the other slots receive FIFO accepted-quartet plus/minus points, weak columns 1/2 and isotropic columns 3/4, up to 48 replacements, with unused slots retaining D0 continuation.
mechanism_contract.anchor_eligibility: Only canonical-valid, strictly interior endpoints with scaled residual 2-norm at most 1e-12 may emit geometry.
mechanism_contract.finite_difference: The bound weak_geometry source uses the frozen h/h2 symmetric finite-difference, uncertainty, singular-gap and projector-stability gates.
mechanism_contract.paired_control: Every accepted weak-direction comparison is paired with the same counter-Gaussian draw, radius and semantic-validity gate for its isotropic control.
mechanism_contract.all_inapplicable_behavior: If no anchor is applicable, geometry emits zero starts and all three Phase-3 arm matrices are bit-identical D0 continuation matrices.
mechanism_contract.local_attempt_contract: Every Phase-1 and Phase-3 local attempt uses frozen E4 with callback cap 600; Phase 3 runs exactly 64 attempts per arm.
mechanism_contract.inapplicability: A typed inapplicable result emits no geometry; it is not interpreted as proof of regularity, isolation or absence of another basin.

decision_boundary.implementation_kill: Any false target, unsafe endpoint, callback mismatch, cap violation, exception, input checksum drift, source-slice mismatch, non-IID D0 lane, truth leak, arm asymmetry or recursive probe emission kills the implementation.
decision_boundary.efficacy_reporting: Report applicability, accepted/rejected quartet counts, safe-full, target recall and callback work separately for weak, paired-isotropic and frozen source-continuation behavior by case and family.
decision_boundary.equal_work_requirement: All arms share the Phase-1 64 source starts and exactly 64 Phase-3 attempt slots. Weak and isotropic matrices share the same case-global schedule; only the paired geometry point selected from each accepted quartet may differ.
decision_boundary.primary_checkpoints: The fixed post-common incremental callback budgets are W in {600,1200,2400,4800}. Common Phase-1 answers are present in every arm and its observed work is reported but cancels in matched comparisons. CONTINUATION is charged zero geometry work; ISOTROPIC and WEAK are each charged the complete observed Phase-2 geometry callback count before their first Phase-3 attempt. At budget W, include the maximal chronological prefix of whole Phase-3 attempts whose charged geometry plus cumulative observed arm callbacks is at most W; an attempt is never split. Thus every checkpoint compares equal total incremental callback work, including proposal-generation work.
decision_boundary.favorable_diagnostic: Weak geometry is only a signal when it improves target recovery or right-censored callback work over its equal-work paired-isotropic control without losing safety, and the direction is not confined to one named case.
decision_boundary.applicability_signal: At least four of eight cases and at least three of four families must produce one or more applicable generation-zero anchors.
decision_boundary.paired_recovery_signal: For a headroom case, WEAK records one and only one case-level strict recovery win when at least one fixed checkpoint W has WEAK's assessor-recomputed count of distinct valid Gold targets strictly greater than both ISOTROPIC and CONTINUATION at the same W. Multiple winning checkpoints do not add wins. The signal requires at least two winning headroom cases from at least two families, including at least one winning case outside TANGENT-CIRCLE-LINE and MULTIROOT-WARPED.
decision_boundary.terminal_noninferiority: For every headroom case separately, after all 64 Phase-3 attempts WEAK's assessor-recomputed distinct valid Gold-target count must be at least the count of each of ISOTROPIC and CONTINUATION, and WEAK's binary safe-full value must be at least each control's binary safe-full value. Pooled or family averages cannot mask a losing case. All implementation-kill safety counts must be zero.
decision_boundary.headroom_rule: A case is NO_HEADROOM exactly when the common Phase-1 endpoint union is safe-full under independent assessor replay before any geometry or arm solve; it remains in safety accounting but is excluded from recovery-signal and terminal-noninferiority denominators. Every other case is a headroom case. If no outside-family headroom case exists, the outside-family clause is INCONCLUSIVE_NO_HEADROOM rather than favorable.
decision_boundary.t0_progression_rule: Only applicability_signal, paired_recovery_signal and terminal_noninferiority together authorize a preregistered multi-replicate Stage-B experiment. Failure records a negative mechanism screen for this frozen design; it is not a production correctness claim.
decision_boundary.rejection_scope: A failed progression rule rejects only this frozen one-replicate mechanism design as a candidate for formal Stage-B. It does not reject weak-direction exploration as a general algorithm class or support a production-performance claim.
decision_boundary.formal_next_step: Only a favorable T0 progression result advances this frozen design to a preregistered multiple-replicate experiment with at least three unrelated families. INCONCLUSIVE_NO_HEADROOM may justify a separately preregistered replacement screen without tuning this result; an ordinary failed progression result is frozen as a negative design decision.
